description: Regulatory authorisations of a French company by SIREN: payment institution, e-money institution, account-information provider, payment agent or exempt entity (EBA PSD2 register, refreshed daily), insurance undertaking (EIOPA), entry in ARCEP's list of electronic-communications identifiers (not proof of operator status), with authorisation dates, licensed PSD2 services, EEA passporting and withdrawals. Use it before paying, onboarding or contracting with a regulated counterparty. Not authorised is an answer too. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_company_licences

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
